sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. • For individuals with a confirmed diagnosis of hepatitis B virus (HBV), testing for Immunoglobulin M antibody to hepatitis B core antigen (IgM anti-HBc) (CPT code 86705) or for HBV deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) (CPT code 87516, CPT code 87517) IS REIMBURSABLE . • Antibody testing for hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection (CPT code 86803, CPT code 86804) IS REIMBURSABLE in any of the following situations : – For screening in pregnant individuals – Once per lifetime for all individuals over 18 years of age – One test every 90 days for any individual with recognized conditions or exposures in any of the following situations: ▪ Children born from an HCV-positive individual ▪ Current sexual partners of HCV-infected persons ▪ Evidence of liver disease ▪ History of incarceration ▪ History of or current hemodialysis ▪ Illicit drug use ▪ Illicit intranasal ▪ Injectable drug use ▪ Presence of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection ▪ Receipt of a blood transfusion or blood component ▪ Receipt of a tattoo ▪ Receipt of an organ transplant • Testing for HCV genotype (CPT code 87902) IS REIMBURSABLE with a confirmed diagnosis of HCV. • Qualitative nucleic acid testing for HCV ribonucleic acid (CPT code 87520, CPT code 87521) IS REIMBURSABLE: – With a confirmed diagnosis of HCV: up to 12 tests per year – As a one-time screen for perinatally exposed infants who are less than one year of age • Quantitative nucleic acid testing for HCV viral load (CPT code 87522) IS REIMBURSABLE once per month not to exceed seven tests in 18 months. • For individuals who have tested negative for HBV and HCV, antibody testing for hepatitis A virus (HAV) (CPT code 86708, CPT code 86709) IS REIMBURSABLE. • For individuals who have tested positive for HBV, antibody testing for hepatitis D virus (HDV) (CPT code 86692, CPT code 87380) IS REIMBURSABLE.
